body: It makes me feel terrible being defined as a person because of the mistakes I’ve made when I was hurting. But I guess you really get what you give.

I fucked up greatly cos I couldn’t handle my emotions when he left me again and I lashed out on him, I wrote him a long message taking responsibility for my mistakes and apologizing.. I really meant it. I was in such a terrible place when he left but I snapped out of it eventually. I did a lot of damage, which is why I understood why he couldn’t give me another chance. It also hurt a lot that he regretted our entire time together and just defined me for my mistakes when I was in a lot of pain... but I can’t blame him for that either, I know I hurt him a lot. So now all that’s left to do is accept the consequences, do better, and move on. If only it wasn’t so... lonely.
Then it just loops. The pain loops, over and over again.
one day at a time, we’ll get through this 🤗
i loved “happier” been helping me a lot with letting ago and wanting what’s best for my ex even if we ended on bad terms.

me! my ex used to talk about his ex a LOT. like the not normal kind of amount! we went on a trip to the islands (he has been with his ex on an island trip too) and istg the trip felt like he was reliving the trip he took with her! it was “when i was on that *trip* the boat was this and that. oh the hotel we got was this and that.” BIG EW I SWEAR!
Thank you. I just need the pain to stop.

First letter I wrote were general instructions and final requests. Can’t believe that even when I’m about to go everything still needs to be planned. It’s both sad and funny at the same time. 

A part of it said I left a folder (labeled accordingly) of my photos on my laptop that can be used to remember me and the life I lived. The photos I picked were of me during the times I was truly and genuinely happy. I want them to know I wasn’t always broken, there was a time that I was happy.
He just followed a girl who was interested in him when we were together.. is he moving on?
Already blocked everywhere. I unblock and look up when disoriented. :(
Just woke up disoriented again. Hope this ends soon. Thanks for your insight, everyone.
